content.comment_body: When attempting to connect [product_name] to a PC over Ethernet, I keep encountering errors related to subnet settings, even though I've checked them multiple times. When I try to assign a new IP address, the process fails. I can attempt to reload the connection in the Ethernet download section, but both the test and upload procedures continue to fail. Any advice?

What are the PC's current IP address and subnet mask settings? What are the IP address and subnet mask configured on the [product_name]? Which hardware version of the [product_name] are you using? Is it [article_no] or [article_no]? Also, what version of [product_name] software do you have installed?

Hello, Try connecting directly to [product_name] using an Ethernet cable. If this resolves the issue, it could indicate that another device on the network is using the same IP address. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing problems connecting [product_name] modules to PCs via Ethernet, mainly due to IP and subnet configuration issues. Efforts to double-check settings and reconnect have not resolved the connection problems. Discussion suggests that address conflicts or complicated network setups may be responsible for failed connections.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that connecting a [product_name] module to their PC over Ethernet should be straightforward and reliable. They look for a simple, plug-and-play process with clear network configuration and automatic recognition, particularly regarding IP and subnet settings.
